scenarios.name: Deterministic Vite & ASAR Application Bundling
scenarios.action: Execute 'npm run package' via Electron Forge from clean state
scenarios.expected_outcome: Produces out/DocuReady-win32-x64 containing app.asar and docuready_sidecar
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Built production Vite bundles and packaged win32-x64 target with zero errors

scenarios.name: Packaged Sidecar Binary Handshake
scenarios.action: Spawn docuready_sidecar.exe in isolated environment and request 'health'
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns protocol 1, healthy status, engine 0.1.0, pdf_backend 'pymupdf'
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Responds with valid JSON frame in <1.2s; verified healthy

scenarios.name: Scenario A — Developer Dependencies Absent
scenarios.action: Run packaged sidecar with PATH stripped of Python/Node/Tesseract and empty PYTHONPATH
scenarios.expected_outcome: Application starts, identifies bundled Tesseract, and executes audit without host Python

scenarios.name: Scenario B — Conflicting Host Environment Isolation
scenarios.expected_outcome: Engine binds exclusively to bundled Tesseract and ignores external system installations
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Discovery logic enforces bundled_resource source and rejects fallback to foreign PATH

scenarios.name: Bundled Multi-Language Traineddata Resolution
scenarios.action: Inspect sidecar health report for installed language models
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Discovered English, Hindi, and Odia neural traineddata in packaged tessdata dir

scenarios.name: Clean Document Packet (pkt_01_clean)
scenarios.action: Execute packaged sidecar audit on clean scholarship packet
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Overall status NO_ISSUES_FOUND, readiness score 100

scenarios.name: Critical Conflict Packet (pkt_02_name_conflict)
scenarios.action: Execute packaged sidecar audit on packet with Aadhaar vs Certificate name conflict
scenarios.expected_outcome: Status: NOT_READY, Fatal finding recorded, score reduced
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Overall status NOT_READY, score 82, fatal name mismatch recorded

scenarios.name: Missing Mandatory Document Packet (pkt_05_missing_certificate)
scenarios.action: Execute packaged sidecar audit on packet omitting income certificate
scenarios.expected_outcome: Status: NOT_READY, MISSING finding recorded with zero hallucinated bounding boxes
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Overall status NOT_READY, score 65, missing document finding has bounding_box: null

scenarios.name: Ambiguous Evidence Packet (pkt_08_ambiguous_evidence)
scenarios.action: Execute packaged sidecar audit on packet with multiple candidate dates
scenarios.expected_outcome: Status: NEEDS_CHECKS, Conservative review abstention triggered
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Overall status NEEDS_CHECKS, review guidance callout rendered

scenarios.name: Workspace Path Traversal Enforcement
scenarios.action: Request packaged audit on packet_dir resolving outside DOCUREADY_WORKSPACE_ROOT
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Request rejected with WORKSPACE_VIOLATION; zero directory traversal allowed

scenarios.name: Offline Isolation & Zero Telemetry Verification
scenarios.action: Monitor network socket creation during full application audit cycle
scenarios.expected_outcome: Zero outbound TCP/UDP connections; zero telemetry; fully local execution
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Verified zero network sockets opened during audit and report export

scenarios.name: Installer & Portable Distribution Creation
scenarios.action: Verify Squirrel Setup executable and Portable ZIP archive
scenarios.expected_outcome: DocuReady-0.1.0-Setup.exe and DocuReady-win32-x64-0.1.0.zip created and valid
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: 457 MB Squirrel installer and 469 MB portable zip verified intact
